topography.project_purpose: Partially Algorithmic Stablecoin. Structurally: 41 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 12 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, adapter). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
